'''Outlaw II Challenges''' are the second level of [[Outlaw Challenges]] in [[Redemption Multiplayer|Red Dead Redemption Multiplayer]]. These challenges are split into the following four categories:

* '''[[Outlaw II - Bounty Hunter Challenge|Bounty Hunter]]'''

* '''[[Outlaw II - Outlaw Gang Challenges|Outlaw Gang]]'''

* '''[[Outlaw II - Public Enemy Killer Challenges|Public Enemy Killer]]'''

* '''[[Outlaw II - Public Enemy Kill Streak Challenges|Public Enemy Kill Streak]]'''
